meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装好后,当你进行 git 操作时,Claude 会先分析仓库现状和提交风格,再把改动拆成多个独立的小提交,每个提交只讲一件事;它也能帮你整理提交历史(如变基、压缩),或查出一段代码是何时由谁加入的。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase、squash 等关键词,或询问某段代码是谁写的、何时加入时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动拆成几个小提交,每个只做一件事。
say.note: 它会按目录和逻辑拆分文件,生成多个提交。

say.text: 把最近的几个提交压缩成一个,并整理好提交信息。
say.note: 它会自动变基合并,并沿用仓库风格重写信息。

say.text: 查一下这段代码是谁写的,什么时候加的?
say.note: 它会用 blame/log 定位来源提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze the repo state and commit style before splitting your changes into multiple small, independent commits. It can also rewrite history (rebase/squash) and trace when/where a piece of code was introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention commit, rebase, squash, or ask who wrote a line / when something was added, or request finding the commit that introduced a change.

say_en.text: Split my changes into several small commits, each with one purpose.
say_en.note: It groups by directory/logic and commits each.

say_en.text: Squash the last few commits into one with a clean message.
say_en.note: Rebases and rewrites messages in repo style.

say_en.text: Find who wrote this line and when it was added.
say_en.note: Uses blame/log to locate the source commit.
